paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Rav Sheva: Megillah, first chapter; I did not find it there. “Rava said: Rav Shmuel bar Sheva said in Rav Huna's name”: Shevuot 17, beginning of side b. There, “Rabbah examined it” should read Rava. Rav was his brother.
